historicalContract.gatewayH07H08H09: unchanged and unqualified for their original claims

profile.reason: Exact source-valid named-permission/discovery/config overrides and native behavior require separately reviewed qualification. No guessed keys or inherited entries.

requiredOverrides: explicit approved nonsecret auth storage backend
native OpenAI provider without credential gateway
untrusted staged project and approved instruction discovery

configOverrides.serialization: Each -c is exactly one argv element key=value. Every value must round-trip a real TOML parser with structural equality before admission: the pinned source splits the key on every '.' without quoting and a value that fails TOML parsing SILENTLY degrades to a raw string, so path-keyed maps are only admissible as inline-table values under dot-free top-level keys (source: #92 F1, codex 0.157.1 @36650394).
configOverrides.mergeSemantics: Tables deep-merge and CLI overrides sit above user/project layers but below thread-config, legacy managed_config and macOS MDM layers; no override can erase inherited map entries such as mcp_servers, hooks, permission profiles or projects. Only a fail-closed discovery inventory (empty/approved before admission) works; no map-erasure semantics may be assumed (source: #92 F2).
configOverrides.strictValidation: --strict-config also validates -c overrides: unknown configuration fields or feature keys are rejected with an explicit error (source: #92 F3).
configOverrides.userLayerScope: --ignore-user-config replaces only the user config.toml layer; the CODEX_HOME skill roots and packaged defaults (credentials store 'file', project_doc_max_bytes, history save-all) still apply beneath, so ignore flags alone never establish absence (source: #92 F4).

forbiddenLaunchInputs: --sandbox/-s or sandbox_mode together with named default_permissions: any CLI sandbox override forces legacy syntax and silently drops the named-permission profile; the combination is rejected by source (source: #92 F7, codex 0.157.1 @36650394)
forced_login_method / forced_chatgpt_workspace_id anywhere in overrides: a mismatch triggers logout of the shared auth (source: #92 F8; consistent with auth.forcedLoginLogoutPolicy=false)

auth-bearing environment keys (CODEX_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, refresh/revoke URL overrides, client-id/base-URL overrides): load_auth honours them and in-process exec enables CODEX_API_KEY, so the positive environment allowlist must exclude them (source: #92 F8)

input.consumptionEvidence: Prompt consumption is evidenced only by a subsequent thread.started: the pinned source reads stdin fully before thread start, and an early config error exits without reading (a write may still succeed into the pipe buffer) (source: #92 F9, codex 0.157.1 @36650394)

launch.environment: sealed positive allowlist, exact immutable bytes; no inherited API/access/workload tokens, proxies, provider overrides or ambient secrets

auth.home: one designated existing harness-owned CODEX_HOME; not private runtime HOME
auth.backend: explicit approved nonsecret file/keyring/auto selection, never inferred from credentials
auth.accountMode: recognized subscription classification only; unknown/API/mismatch rejects before model work
auth.normalNativeRefresh: allowed only within later qualified profile authority
auth.trustPersistence: thread/start with a requested writable cwd and no trust_level persists projects.<git-root-or-cwd>.trust_level='trusted' into the shared CODEX_HOME config.toml; with a shared store this mutates the user's real config. The profile must prevent it with an explicit untrusted override for the canonical staged root (trust_level Some => no persistence) and a projectless staged tree, and post-run must verify the shared config.toml bytes are unchanged (source: #92 F5, codex 0.157.1 @36650394)

protocol.kind: fresh codex exec JSONL; not external JSON-RPC
successRequires: unique consistent item identities and valid lifecycle

all observed items settled with truthful terminal outcomes; a started todo_list must settle, but its task state is informational only — the pinned exec synthesizes todo completion at the end of every turn regardless of steps actually done, so plan state is never evidence of work performed (source: #92 F10, codex 0.157.1 @36650394, event_processor_with_jsonl_output.rs:514-523)
one current structured final after tool settlement
no errors/reroutes/policy or authority denials/declined operations
strict complete bounded stdout JSONL and stderr EOF
unchanged admission identity, no cancellation, original deadline
protocol.sourceVisibilityGap: Omitted internal state needs exact source/native qualification; absence of JSONL field is not absence of activity.
protocol.successMeaning: Protocol-qualified current proposal only; never authoritative checks/review/CI or delivery acceptance.

toolOutcomeClasses.settledOrdinaryFailure: A fully observed nonzero diagnostic command or recoverable patch failure does not alone reject a later correctly bound proposal. Preserve exact status/exit/output/item history; all other protocol/fence/usage/EOF/cleanup predicates still apply.
toolOutcomeClasses.unresolvedOrUnknown: Pending, ambiguous, missing, malformed or contradictory settlement rejects a successful proposal; never relabel it ordinary failure.
toolOutcomeClasses.policyOrFatal: Actual policy/authority denial, declined operation, reroute, error/turn.failed or fatal harness failure rejects a successful proposal; no model assertion can erase it.
toolOutcomeClasses.errorItemSurface: In the pinned source the error class is broader than fatal failures: ConfigWarning, Warning, DeprecationNotice, model reroute and 'event stream lagged; dropped N events' surface as item.completed{type:error}, and every Error notification including will_retry reconnects surfaces as a top-level error event; all reject fail-closed, so flaky network yields honest false negatives. An interrupted turn emits no terminal event and exits 1: interrupted/unknown, never success. With --ephemeral there is no thread/read backfill, so started items missing at turn end stay unresolved and reject (source: #92 F10, codex 0.157.1 @36650394).
toolOutcomeClasses.classificationAuthority: Source-bound observed outcomes, not model prose; a failed item status alone is not an action-failure verdict.
toolOutcomeClasses.mandatoryChecks: An unresolved mandatory host-check failure or blocking finding prevents delivery until independently resolved for current inputs; a proposal or later successful diagnostic is not that receipt.

one active invocation until proven quiescent
budget.comparisonTotal: input_tokens + output_tokens; cached/reasoning subsets not added again; source interpretation must qualify
budget.actualProviderConsumption: unknown; not inferred from telemetry or planning charges
budget.planningCharges: separate monotonic local entitlement, no refunds from unknown or zero-default usage
budget.automaticAgentStop: any unresolved usage OR accumulated reported total >= configured threshold; applies to implement/review/arbitrate/all repairs
budget.overrun: retain full reported amount; stop further automatic agent work; never clip or call provider-receipt

attemptPolicy.totalFreshActions: finite positive integer frozen at admission

budget.ciReserveLimit: Review exhaustion cannot spend CI entitlement; uncertainty/threshold can block CI agent repair and subscription quota is never guaranteed.
budget.legacy: No mode defaulting, in-place promotion, capability conversion, receipt relabeling or unknown-success clearance; explicit new-run/revision boundary with fresh independent binding.

Independently approved immutable evidence binding, trusted loader, real functional/visual gates and drift checks.
